current_date: 10 November 2025 (date from which the Local Validation Requirements and BNG Requirements apply, stated on the council's Submitting a Planning Application page)
current_evidence: The council's live Submitting a Planning Application page (last modified Oct 2026) and Planning & Building landing page both say applications must meet the Local Validation Requirements (LVR) and Biodiversity Net Gain Requirements (BNGR) introduced for applications submitted on or after 10 November 2025, and link them as a SharePoint folder; Grokbot's URL loads this same page.

issues.detail: Grokbot captured no requirements at all (Req. items 0, every app type row says 'Not covered'), even though Mole Valley adopted a local list, the Local Validation Requirements (LVR) plus a separate Biodiversity Net Gain Requirements (BNGR) checklist, in force since 10 November 2025. The whole local list is missing from the workbook.
issues.evidence: Submitting a Planning Application page: the Local Validation Requirements and Biodiversity Net Gain Requirements apply to applications submitted on and after Monday 10 November 2025.

issues.detail: The 'Validation list URL' is the generic how-to-submit page (an old path that shows the same content as /planning-building/submitting-a-planning-application/), not the list itself. The actual LVR/BNGR documents are in a SharePoint folder linked from that page. That folder is the link that should be recorded.
issues.evidence: Link text 'Local Validation Requirements and Biodiversity Net Gain Requirements' -> molevalleydc.sharepoint.com/:f:/s/MVDCDocumentLibrary/... (folder link)

issues.detail: List date and Date basis are blank, but the council page gives an effective date of 10 November 2025 for the current requirements.
issues.evidence: 'introduced ... for applications submitted on or after Monday 10 November 2025'

issues.detail: Status 'Link only (not readable: blocked/404/login)' is wrong for the recorded URL, which loads normally. Only the linked SharePoint folder can't be fetched by an automated tool (robots disallowed). A person can open it, so the list should be read by hand rather than marked unreadable.
issues.evidence: Recorded URL fetched successfully; SharePoint folder fetch failed with robots_disallowed.

issues.detail: Grokbot read the October 2024 news item about the consultation on a *proposed* Local Validation Checklist (consultation 30 Sep to 11 Nov 2024), but didn't record that the list was later adopted and took effect on 10 Nov 2025. The URL source was a third-party directory (planninggeek), not verified. Also, the government planning.data.gov.uk record still says 'We do not currently have a local validation list'. That record is stale and should not be relied on.
issues.evidence: news.molevalley.gov.uk 1 Oct 2024: Cabinet agreed 24 Sep 2024 to consult on a proposed new Local Validation Checklist; planning.data.gov.uk mole-valley-local-area-requirements note.

summary: Grokbot's link loads the council's submission page, which leads to the current LVR and BNGR (effective 10 Nov 2025), but Grokbot captured no requirements and recorded no date. The list documents sit in a SharePoint folder that couldn't be fetched automatically, so their contents could not be compared and still need a manual read.
